responsibility: Implements operations on polynomial chains of recurrences (CHRECs), GCC’s symbolic representation of scalar evolution in loops. It folds arithmetic on recurrences, handles nested-loop and multivariate cases, performs conversions and aggressive narrowing rewrites, compares and traverses evolution expressions, classifies monotonic direction and linearity, and provides the algebraic backbone used by scalar-evolution, iteration-count, dependence, and loop-transformation code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CHREC/scalar-evolution algorithms declared in gcc/tree-chrec.h—folding recurrence arithmetic, conversions, equality and direction queries, and linearity traversal—while the header provides the inline predicates, builders, and API declarations.
